method: Actual Chromium pages; local Supabase mocks

checks.scenario: Admin opens User Management directly, lists profiles despite a broken legacy RPC, and creates User accounts with only Admin/User choices
Revoked or banned access clears the account directory, closes the form and disables export
User opening an Admin URL is redirected to the User workspace despite a forged Admin browser cache
A database error is shown inside the registry with disabled actions; the Admin workspace remains visible without an extra access screen
Mobile registry and account role form remain usable without horizontal page overflow
Without JavaScript only the static Admin shell is visible, with no personnel account data or separate access card
Admin login routes to its corresponding workspace using the Supabase profile
User login routes to its corresponding workspace using the Supabase profile
